title: Choose the next step from the evidence

nodes.label: Complete, all requirements pass
nodes.detail: Consider one separately funded trial with a second team.

nodes.label: Evidence missing; no requirement failed
nodes.detail: One bounded extension, only if the eligibility conditions hold.

nodes.label: A completed requirement fails
nodes.detail: Stop expansion. A revised workflow needs a new proposal.

textEquivalent: Complete evidence passing every requirement can support one separately funded second-team trial. Missing evidence may qualify for the single bounded extension only under the stated conditions. A completed failed requirement stops expansion. Any prohibited action, data exposure or High/Medium incident requires immediate suspension, independently of this final readout.
